target_customer: Commercial real estate owners and, later, energy retailers and heat pump makers needing demand flexibility
problem: Buildings use electricity at expensive, high emission times and lack automated ways to shift load and sell flexibility to the grid.
business_model: Software and flexibility services sharing grid revenue
product_category: Demand response and building energy optimization

technical_complexity.rationale: Forecasting building loads and dispatching HVAC against electricity prices with ML, integrated with building systems, was moderately hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with device makers and accumulated load data helped, though optimization logic could be copied by energy software firms.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it; EnergyHub bought it in December 2024 to expand virtual power plants into Europe.

market_need_then: European electrification and dynamic electricity pricing created demand for load shifting; the company claimed early trials cut power costs 25% and CO2 10% (self reported, TechCrunch 2021-08).

brand_strength.rationale: No sources about the brand were found; the name resembles Capacity, Capacities and kapa.ai, which crowd search results.

pivots.to: Heat pump optimization and residential flexibility
pivots.why: Not stated in sources; inferred only from the company's later positioning, so treat as unconfirmed.

outcome_analysis: Kapacity.io sold AI load shifting for buildings into a European market moving to electrification and dynamic pricing, then refocused on heat pumps and was acquired by EnergyHub in December 2024. Funding found is only about 125K to 130K of pre-seed on aggregators, so the exit was reached on little disclosed capital, suggesting capital efficiency but unverified.
notes: YC page says acquired November 2024; press release dated 2024-12-09. Seedtable and Crunchbase show about 125K to 130K pre-seed in 2021 (aggregators only), unverified, not recorded as a round. Pivot date and reason are unconfirmed. No competitors named in 2021 coverage, so list empty. Completeness pass: one round recorded on the strength of a single database or outlet, Seedtable for the amount (TheCompanyCheck says 125K in 2021-09); TechCrunch of 2021-08-23 confirms a pre-seed from Nordic Makers without an amount. No primary announcement found.
